feeds.title: Jay I. Swanson, DDS, Blog
feeds.description: Follow our blog to get the latest news and updates from The Center for Jaw and Facial Surgery, P.C. Our oral surgeon can diagnose and correct deformities, injuries and other conditions. Dr. Swanson is Effingham County's only board-certified specialist in oral and maxillofacial surgery. Regain your self-confidence with a facial reconstruction surgery.
